- **When to use**: When input data is scattered or non-uniform and must be converted to a regular grid for volume texture generation [S3, unofficial].

The claim states that the evidence supports the use of a preprocessing step to convert irregular/non-uniform data into regular grids for volume texture generation. The provided text explicitly mentions addressing 'uneven structure of the data grids' to make them 'suitable for shader programming' and describes specific interpolation methods (spline interpolation) used to create regular grids (401 vertical layers, 300x300 horizontal grids) from non-uniform data. It also defines volume textures as being used to store volume data for rendering. All factual components of the claim are present and consistent with the evidence.
